title: Enterprise Use Case and Target Architecture

lanes.title: Customer request
lanes.connection: Retrieval reads the source/index state below. Model Gateway uses the approved release below. Result commit precedes saved success.

nodes.title: Client and regional API Gateway
nodes.description: Enter through a tenant-approved regional boundary; caller scope is verified.

nodes.title: Identity/Policy Service
nodes.description: Current tenant, user and resource policy; mandatory disclosure audit.

nodes.title: Admission and fair budgets
nodes.description: Bound waiting work, deadlines, request/token quotas and active slots.

nodes.title: AI App Service
nodes.description: Run the supplier task and preserve its scoped operation identity.

nodes.title: Authorised retrieval
nodes.description: Resolve current permitted source passages before model disclosure.

nodes.title: Model Gateway and approved serving
nodes.description: Pin the approved bundle/profile; hosted route or justified self-hosted/GPU option.

nodes.title: Durable operations and result/history
nodes.description: Save known completion and original evidence; inspect incomplete/unknown outcomes.

lanes.title: Enterprise document ingestion
lanes.connection: Publishes the current source, version and search state used by authorised retrieval; old events cannot undo a newer deletion.

nodes.title: Approved enterprise sources
nodes.description: Tenant-approved source scope and versioned change/delete events.

nodes.title: Document Ingestion, Queue and Workers
nodes.description: Durable jobs prepare bounded parsing/chunking and publish progress.

nodes.title: Immutable source objects and bounded cache
nodes.description: Keep versioned passages and provenance; cache reuse still needs current access.

nodes.title: Metadata DB and Search Index
nodes.description: Current versions, tombstones, access metadata and published searchable passages.

lanes.title: Quality and model lifecycle
lanes.connection: Optional training and registry feed evaluation; an existing approved model needs no new training job. Evaluation and approval supply the immutable release identity used by Model Gateway.

nodes.title: Optional datasets and Fine-Tuning Jobs
nodes.description: Separately approved data, pinned recipe/base, experiments and verified checkpoints.

nodes.title: Model Registry
nodes.description: Immutable candidate lineage; route-friendly aliases do not replace version evidence.

nodes.title: Evaluation Service and trusted approval
nodes.description: Frozen task/safety cases and candidate-bound evidence before promotion.

nodes.title: Versioned release bundle
nodes.description: Bind prompt, retrieval, model and policy configuration; eligible canary and rollback.

lanes.title: Platform, region and operations
lanes.connection: Configures eligible regional execution and records evidence. Global control does not process customer prompts.

nodes.title: Versioned app manifests and migration controller
nodes.description: Named app owner, validated desired state, read-only shadow and controlled cutover.

nodes.title: Placement and regional recovery
nodes.description: A/B EU cells; C US-home; one writer and verified recovery eligibility.

nodes.title: Serving and capacity operations
nodes.description: Measure ready replicas/GPU options and reserve actual regional dependency headroom.

nodes.title: Audit, Telemetry and usage evidence
nodes.description: Trace decisions, protect logs, inspect unknown effects and count all workflow spend.

stages.title: Build the MVP
stages.pressure: A single enterprise user can authenticate, ask a question, receive a hosted-model response, and view a saved request.

stages.title: Distributed Execution
stages.pressure: Document processing and long-running tasks block interactive requests or are lost on worker failure.

stages.title: Enterprise Knowledge
stages.pressure: Users need trustworthy answers from changing internal documents without exposing restricted files.

stages.title: Scale the Application
stages.pressure: Traffic rises from a pilot to broad enterprise usage; latency and database load rise.

stages.title: Handle Overload and Fair Scheduling
stages.pressure: One tenant floods a shared model provider; others miss latency targets and queues grow.

stages.title: Enterprise Security
stages.pressure: Multiple customer organizations demand strict isolation, identity, audit, and private connectivity.

stages.title: Reliability and Consistency
stages.pressure: Replica lag, crashes, dependency outages, and retries yield stale states or duplicate effects.

stages.title: Production AI Quality and Releases
stages.pressure: A model or retrieval change silently reduces accuracy or increases cost and latency.

stages.title: Inference and GPU Infrastructure
stages.pressure: Hosted provider spend and latency force evaluation of routing and self-hosted serving.

stages.title: Fine-Tuning and Model Customization
stages.pressure: Selected customers require specialized model behavior; ad-hoc training cannot be governed.

stages.title: Global Multi-Region Platform
stages.pressure: Data residency, regional traffic, outages, and enterprise SLAs change deployment constraints.

stages.title: Staff-Level Platform Architecture
stages.pressure: The platform must serve many internal teams and customers without becoming a fragile custom project.

steps.label: Identify and place
steps.owner: API Gateway and Identity/Policy Service
steps.input: Alice’s verified principal, tenant policy and proposed regional ingress.
steps.output: Trusted Tenant A scope and an allowed processing region are established.
steps.failure: Spoofed scope or wrong-region processing must reject before protected disclosure.

steps.label: Inspect and admit
steps.owner: AI App Service, operation store and admission
steps.input: Stable scoped operation key, request shape, deadline and queue limits.
steps.output: A new bounded operation or inspection of the original existing operation.
steps.failure: Changed payload conflicts; duplicate identity does not grant another model attempt.

steps.label: Gather evidence
steps.owner: Authorised retrieval, current policy and Metadata DB
steps.input: Supplier question and current source/version/access authority.
steps.output: Permitted supplier-policy:v1:c0 context and exact provenance.
steps.failure: Deleted, stale, forbidden or absent evidence blocks the grounded answer.

steps.label: Select and reserve
steps.owner: Model Gateway, approved release and shared budgets
steps.input: Bounded permitted context, approved route/profile and candidate bundle.
steps.output: Eligible route is pinned and fresh request/token/slot capacity reserved.
steps.failure: An unapproved, unready or over-budget route cannot dispatch.

steps.label: Generate
steps.owner: Approved serving adapter
steps.input: Permitted bounded request sent to the approved hosted or self-hosted route.
steps.output: Known model result is available for validation and final persistence.
steps.failure: A lost response can mean execution and charging occurred; no blind alternate call.

steps.label: Commit
steps.owner: Durable operation and result store
steps.input: Known answer, original bundle and original source references.
steps.output: Committed answer/history state exists before a saved-success response.
steps.failure: Failed final commit cannot acknowledge a completed saved answer.

steps.label: Reopen and observe
steps.owner: Scoped history, current policy, audit and Telemetry
steps.input: Alice’s result identity with original evidence and current read permissions.
steps.output: Permitted saved result is reopened and outcome/usage evidence inspected.
steps.failure: Another tenant cannot read it; revoked original evidence may block protected replay.
